title: Turn meeting notes into an action-item table with owners and due dates; decisions are not actions

turns.prompt: Turn my meeting notes in {D}/standup-2026-10-28.md into an action-item list: one row per action with owner, task and due date (YYYY-MM-DD, or 'none' if no date was set), saved as a Markdown table in {D}/actions.md. A decision with no owner is not an action item. Then tell me which actions have no due date.
turns.seed:
mkdir -p {D} && cat > {D}/standup-2026-10-28.md <<'EOF'
# Platform sync - 28 Oct 2026
Attendees: Lena, Omar, Priya, Tomas

- Lena: the billing export still drops rows with a comma in the customer name. She'll fix the CSV quoting by Monday 2 Nov.
- Omar said the deploy pipeline was flaky twice this week; he'll look into it (no date set).
- Priya will send the Q4 vendor shortlist to finance by Friday 30 Oct.
- We agreed to move the retro to Thursdays.
- Tomas owns the on-call handbook update, due 6 Nov.
- Lena and Priya pair on the SSO migration plan, draft by 9 Nov, Priya leads.
EOF
turns.verify:
f={D}/actions.md; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no actions.md; exit 0; }
python3 - "$f" <<'EOF'
import re, sys
rows = [l for l in open(sys.argv[1]) if l.strip().startswith('|')]
rows = [r for r in rows if not re.fullmatch(r'[\s|:\-]+', r.strip())]
body = rows[1:] if rows else []
low = [r.lower() for r in body]
print(f"SHOW rows={len(body)}")
for r in body: print("SHOW " + r.strip()[:160])
need = ["2026-11-02", "2026-10-30", "2026-11-06", "2026-11-09"]
miss = [d for d in need if not any(d in r for r in body)]
omar = [r for r in low if "omar" in r]
omar_ok = bool(omar) and any(re.search(r"\bnone\b|n/a|\u2014|no date", r) for r in omar)
retro = any("retro" in r for r in low)
if len(body) == 5 and not miss and omar_ok and not retro:
    print("PASS")
else:
    print(f"FAIL: rows={len(body)} missing_dates={miss} omar_undated={omar_ok} retro_listed={retro}")
EOF

rubric.criteria: Pass if actions.md holds exactly five actions (Lena CSV quoting 2026-11-02, Omar flaky deploy with no date, Priya vendor shortlist 2026-10-30, Tomas handbook 2026-11-06, Priya SSO plan 2026-11-09), the retro decision is left out, and the reply names Omar's item as the one without a date. Fail if dates are wrong, an action is invented or dropped, or the reply claims dates the notes do not give.

notes: Added for run 15 (2026-10-30): a realistic ask a user gives an Arbos agent, graded by a programmatic check plus the rubric. Checks date resolution from weekday+day phrases and that a decision is not turned into a task.
